overview: This Senate resolution elects Jackie Barber of South Dakota as Secretary of the Senate, effective January 3, 2025. The Secretary of the Senate is the chamber's chief administrative officer, responsible for its official records, finances, legislative clerks, and other support staff. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 3, 2025.
for: Supporters say filling this post promptly ensures the Senate's administrative work runs smoothly from the first day of the new Congress.
against: Critics say the resolution is a routine personnel decision that does not change any law or policy.
